entities.summary: Roger Douglas, a notable figure in the history of New Zealand, associated with Rogernomics and Economic Reform (1984–1990). Preceded by Fourth Labour Government Reforms and NZ Nuclear Free 1987. Their legacy influenced Employment Contracts Act (1991) and MMP Introduction.
